articles.headline: UConn's Nik Khamenia to have foot surgery, be rechecked in 6-8 weeks
articles.description: UConn coach Dan Hurley said Thursday that starting forward Nik Khamenia will have surgery on his left foot and be reevaluated in six to eight weeks.

articles.headline: No. 4 UConn rolls past Wagner 83-41 but loses forward Nik Khamenia to injury
articles.description: — Silas Demary Jr. had 18 points and a career-high six steals to lead fourth-ranked UConn to a 83-41 win over Wagner on Monday night.

articles.headline: Kansas' Melvin Council Jr. suffers broken foot, might be out until January
articles.description: Kansas guard Melvin Council Jr. suffered a broken foot in practice Monday and could be out until the start of Big 12 conference play which begins in January.

articles.headline: Illinois' David Mirkovic undergoes emergency appendectomy
articles.description: David Mirkovic, who had offseason foot surgery that is expected to sideline him at the start of the season, underwent an emergency appendectomy Saturday night.
